Class ErrorPayload

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.error.ErrorPayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
ErrorServerPayload, ServerPayload, Serializable
public class ErrorPayload extends Object implements Serializable, ErrorServerPayload
Payload sent by the server to report an application or validation error to the client.

This contains a standardized error code along with a human-readable message description.
